verdict.rationale: Databricks' Delta table history docs say you can query a table at a specific point in time using time travel and roll back a table, which covers point-in-time queries and restoring corrupted tables. The evidence is a single first-party sentence, so depth and recovery of dropped tables are unproven. Missing for 10: evidence for restoring dropped tables (undrop/recovery of deleted tables), detail on retention windows and syntax, independent or hands-on corroboration.
